newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Sogecable in accord with Spielberg group.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Sogecable in accord with Spielberg group.

text.p: Spanish pay television giant Sogecable said on Thursday it had reached a deal with U.S. film director Steven Spielberg's Dreamworks SKG for exclusive television rights in Spain.
In a statement, Sogecable said the deal would allow it to broadcast films on pay-TV channel Canal Plus.
The deal initially involves the television rights of around 40 Dreamworks' productions.
France's Canal Plus holds a 25 percent stake in Sogecable.

Another 25 percent is in the hands of Prisa group, while Spanish bank BBV and Banca March each hold 15.79 percent. A 7.84 percent stake is held by retailer Sociedad de Eventos (Grupo Corte Ingles), and the remaining 5.26 percent is in the hands of Bankinter and Caja Madrid.
Sogecable manages Canal Plus in Spain.
